name: kondi-facebook-mcp
description: MCP server for Facebook/Meta Graph API — post, read, and delete page content

tools.name: fb_page_post
tools.description: Publish a post to a Facebook Page's feed. Supports text messages and optional link attachments.

tools.name: fb_get_page_posts
tools.description: Retrieve recent posts from a Facebook Page's feed with configurable limit.

tools.name: fb_get_post
tools.description: Get details of a specific Facebook post including message, created time, and like count.

tools.name: fb_delete_post
tools.description: Delete a specific Facebook post by its post ID.
